items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: Kenneth Pitts and stayed in Fort Worth. And now this was with, with the Doe Boys.

ctx.x: Very famous. Kenneth Pitts and stayed in Fort Worth. And now this was with, with the Doe Boys. Doe Boys, yes. Those two were going to school at TCU studying. Both of them finally then got their BAs and they played, oh, the Bach Two Violet Concerto and kept telling the teacher about the piano player they had out there and what he was doing and all and one time arranged for me to go out and meet Keith Mixon kind of on an audition and that was a turning point in my life then. When I finally met the piano teacher,…
